title: 국가안보실 직제 / queue:ADDENDUM:28047:20170511:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Addenda <Presidential Decree No. 28047, May 11, 2017>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Personnel Quotas)
Notwithstanding the attached Table, a personnel quota corresponding to the number of public officials who belonged to the former Office of National Security (excluding political service officials) at the time this Decree enters into force shall be deemed separately established within the Office of National Security until May 31, 2018. Provided, however, that where the incumbent officials are special-service public officials, the quota shall be deemed separately established until June 30, 2017, and where they are fixed-term public officials, until the expiration of their respective terms. [Amended on May 30, 2017.]
